import bpy, bmesh, math
from mathutils import Vector, Matrix
sc = bpy.context.scene
sc.render.engine = 'BLENDER_EEVEE_NEXT' if 'BLENDER_EEVEE_NEXT' in [e.identifier for e in bpy.types.RenderSettings.bl_rna.properties['engine'].enum_items] else 'BLENDER_EEVEE'
sc.render.resolution_x, sc.render.resolution_y, sc.render.resolution_percentage = 1280, 720, 100
sc.render.fps = 24; sc.frame_start = 1; sc.frame_end = 120

def mat(name, col, rough=0.5, metal=0.0):
    m = bpy.data.materials.get(name) or bpy.data.materials.new(name)
    m.use_nodes = True
    b = m.node_tree.nodes.get('Principled BSDF')
    b.inputs['Base Color'].default_value = (*col, 1); b.inputs['Roughness'].default_value = rough; b.inputs['Metallic'].default_value = metal
    m.diffuse_color = (*col, 1)
    return m

M = dict(asphalt=mat('Asphalt',(0.05,0.05,0.055),0.9), grass=mat('Grass',(0.08,0.3,0.06),1.0),
 line=mat('LineWhite',(0.9,0.9,0.9),0.6), red=mat('CurbRed',(0.8,0.05,0.03),0.6),
 body=mat('CarBody',(0.02,0.35,0.85),0.3,0.3), accent=mat('CarAccent',(1.0,0.55,0.0),0.4),
 dark=mat('CarDark',(0.03,0.03,0.03),0.5), glass=mat('Glass',(0.05,0.08,0.12),0.1,0.5),
 tire=mat('Tire',(0.02,0.02,0.02),0.95), rim=mat('Rim',(0.7,0.7,0.72),0.3,1.0))

# path: straight +Y, right-hand 90deg corner R=15, straight +X
R=15.0; L1=40.0; A=math.pi/2*R; L2=35.0
TOTAL=L1+A+L2
def path(s):
    if s<=L1: return Vector((0,-L1+s,0)), Vector((0,1,0))
    if s<=L1+A:
        t=(s-L1)/R
        return Vector((R-R*math.cos(t), R*math.sin(t),0)), Vector((math.sin(t),math.cos(t),0))
    u=s-L1-A
    return Vector((R+u, R,0)), Vector((1,0,0))
def pathx(s):  # extended beyond ends
    if s<0: p,d=path(0); return p+d*s,d
    if s>TOTAL: p,d=path(TOTAL); return p+d*(s-TOTAL),d
    return path(s)

def new_obj(name, me, m=None):
    o=bpy.data.objects.new(name, me); sc.collection.objects.link(o)
    if m: me.materials.append(m)
    return o

def strip(name, s0, s1, off0, off1, z, m, step=1.0):
    bm=bmesh.new(); n=max(2,int((s1-s0)/step)+1); prev=None
    for i in range(n):
        s=s0+(s1-s0)*i/(n-1); p,d=pathx(s); nrm=Vector((d.y,-d.x,0))
        a=bm.verts.new(p+nrm*off0+Vector((0,0,z))); b=bm.verts.new(p+nrm*off1+Vector((0,0,z)))
        if prev: bm.faces.new((prev[0],prev[1],b,a))
        prev=(a,b)
    me=bpy.data.meshes.new(name); bm.to_mesh(me); bm.free()
    return new_obj(name, me, m)

col = bpy.data.collections.new('Circuit'); sc.collection.children.link(col)
def tocol(o):
    sc.collection.objects.unlink(o); col.objects.link(o); return o

tocol(strip('Road', -15, TOTAL+20, -5, 5, 0.02, M['asphalt']))
tocol(strip('EdgeLineL', -15, TOTAL+20, -4.8, -4.55, 0.03, M['line']))
tocol(strip('EdgeLineR', -15, TOTAL+20, 4.55, 4.8, 0.03, M['line']))
# center dashes
bm=bmesh.new()
s=-15
while s<TOTAL+20:
    p,d=pathx(s); q,e=pathx(s+2.5)
    for a,b in [(p,q)]:
        n1=Vector((d.y,-d.x,0))*0.12; n2=Vector((e.y,-e.x,0))*0.12; z=Vector((0,0,0.03))
        vs=[bm.verts.new(v+z) for v in (p-n1,p+n1,q+n2,q-n2)]; bm.faces.new(vs)
    s+=5
me=bpy.data.meshes.new('CenterDashes'); bm.to_mesh(me); bm.free(); tocol(new_obj('CenterDashes',me,M['line']))
# start/finish line
bm=bmesh.new()
for i in range(10):
    for j in range(2):
        x=-5+i; y=-L1+8+j*0.5
        vs=[bm.verts.new((x,y,0.035)),bm.verts.new((x+1,y,0.035)),bm.verts.new((x+1,y+0.5,0.035)),bm.verts.new((x,y+0.5,0.035))]
        f=bm.faces.new(vs); f.material_index=(i+j)%2
me=bpy.data.meshes.new('StartLine'); bm.to_mesh(me); bm.free()
o=new_obj('StartLine',me,M['line']); me.materials.append(M['dark']); tocol(o)
# curbs at corner (alternating red/white), raised slightly
for side,(o0,o1) in (('In',(4.8,6.3)),('Out',(-6.3,-4.8))):
    bm=bmesh.new(); s=L1-6; k=0
    while s<L1+A+6:
        p,d=pathx(s); q,e=pathx(s+1.5)
        n1=Vector((d.y,-d.x,0)); n2=Vector((e.y,-e.x,0)); z=Vector((0,0,0.06))
        vs=[bm.verts.new(v+z) for v in (p+n1*o0,p+n1*o1,q+n2*o1,q+n2*o0)]
        f=bm.faces.new(vs); f.material_index=k%2; k+=1; s+=1.5
    me=bpy.data.meshes.new('Curb'+side); bm.to_mesh(me); bm.free()
    o=new_obj('Curb'+side,me,M['red']); me.materials.append(M['line']); tocol(o)
# grass ground
bpy.ops.mesh.primitive_plane_add(size=1, location=(10,0,0))
g=bpy.context.object; g.name='Grass'; g.scale=(160,160,1); g.data.materials.append(M['grass'])
sc.collection.objects.unlink(g); col.objects.link(g)
# outer barrier wall along outside of track
b=strip('BarrierBase',-15,TOTAL+20,-9.5,-9.0,0.0,M['line'],1.0)
sol=b.modifiers.new('h','SOLIDIFY'); tocol(b)
bm=bmesh.new(); prev=None; n=int(TOTAL+35)
for i in range(n+1):
    s=-15+(TOTAL+35)*i/n; p,d=pathx(s); nr=Vector((d.y,-d.x,0))
    a=bm.verts.new(p+nr*-9.25); c=bm.verts.new(p+nr*-9.25+Vector((0,0,1.0)))
    if prev: bm.faces.new((prev[0],a,c,prev[1]))
    prev=(a,c)
me=bpy.data.meshes.new('Barrier'); bm.to_mesh(me); bm.free()
bpy.data.objects.remove(b)
bo=new_obj('Barrier',me,M['red']); bo.modifiers.new('thick','SOLIDIFY').thickness=0.4; tocol(bo)
print(sc.render.engine, TOTAL)

import bpy, bmesh, math
from mathutils import Vector
sc=bpy.context.scene
M={m.name:m for m in bpy.data.materials}
carcol=bpy.data.collections.new('Car'); sc.collection.children.link(carcol)
def obj(name, bm, mats, parent=None, loc=(0,0,0)):
    me=bpy.data.meshes.new(name); bm.to_mesh(me); bm.free()
    for m in mats: me.materials.append(M[m])
    o=bpy.data.objects.new(name,me); carcol.objects.link(o); o.location=loc
    if parent: o.parent=parent
    for p in me.polygons: p.use_smooth=False
    return o

root=bpy.data.objects.new('RaceCar',None); carcol.objects.link(root); root.empty_display_size=1.5

# body loft: (y, half width bottom, half width top, z bottom, z top)
secs=[(-2.2,0.85,0.75,0.18,0.62),(-1.6,0.95,0.85,0.15,0.66),(-0.6,0.98,0.88,0.15,0.62),
      (0.6,0.92,0.75,0.15,0.55),(1.5,0.75,0.55,0.15,0.42),(2.3,0.55,0.35,0.15,0.28)]
bm=bmesh.new(); rings=[]
for y,wb,wt,zb,zt in secs:
    ch=0.1
    pts=[(-wb,zb),(wb,zb),(wb+0.03,zt-ch),(wt,zt),(-wt,zt),(-wb-0.03,zt-ch)]
    rings.append([bm.verts.new((x,y,z)) for x,z in pts])
for a,b in zip(rings,rings[1:]):
    for i in range(6):
        bm.faces.new((a[i],a[(i+1)%6],b[(i+1)%6],b[i]))
bm.faces.new(list(reversed(rings[0]))); bm.faces.new(rings[-1])
bmesh.ops.recalc_face_normals(bm,faces=bm.faces)
body=obj('CarBody',bm,['CarBody'],root)

def box(name,c,s,mat,parent=root,taper=None):
    bm=bmesh.new(); bmesh.ops.create_cube(bm,size=1)
    for v in bm.verts:
        v.co.x*=s[0]; v.co.y*=s[1]; v.co.z*=s[2]
        if taper and v.co.z>0: v.co.x*=taper[0]; v.co.y*=taper[1]
    return obj(name,bm,[mat],parent,c)

# cockpit canopy (tapered wedge)
bm=bmesh.new()
pts=[(-0.55,-0.9,0.6),(0.55,-0.9,0.6),(0.55,0.7,0.55),(-0.55,0.7,0.55),
     (-0.38,-0.6,0.98),(0.38,-0.6,0.98),(0.32,0.05,0.95),(-0.32,0.05,0.95)]
v=[bm.verts.new(p) for p in pts]
for f in [(0,1,2,3),(4,7,6,5),(0,4,5,1),(1,5,6,2),(2,6,7,3),(3,7,4,0)]: bm.faces.new([v[i] for i in f])
bmesh.ops.recalc_face_normals(bm,faces=bm.faces)
obj('Canopy',bm,['Glass'],root)
# side pods / accent stripes
box('StripeC',(0,0.2,0.635),(0.3,3.6,0.03),'CarAccent')
box('SidePodL',(-0.98,-0.3,0.35),(0.12,1.8,0.3),'CarAccent')
box('SidePodR',(0.98,-0.3,0.35),(0.12,1.8,0.3),'CarAccent')
# front splitter
box('Splitter',(0,2.15,0.12),(1.7,0.5,0.05),'CarDark')
# rear wing
box('WingPostL',(-0.45,-2.0,0.85),(0.06,0.15,0.45),'CarDark')
box('WingPostR',(0.45,-2.0,0.85),(0.06,0.15,0.45),'CarDark')
box('Wing',(0,-2.1,1.1),(1.9,0.45,0.06),'CarAccent')
box('WingPlateL',(-0.97,-2.1,1.05),(0.04,0.55,0.3),'CarDark')
box('WingPlateR',(0.97,-2.1,1.05),(0.04,0.55,0.3),'CarDark')
box('Diffuser',(0,-2.25,0.25),(1.5,0.2,0.15),'CarDark')

# wheels: 10-sided cylinders, axle along X
wheels=[]
r=0.36
for nm,(x,y) in {'FL':(-0.95,1.35),'FR':(0.95,1.35),'RL':(-0.97,-1.35),'RR':(0.97,-1.35)}.items():
    hub=bpy.data.objects.new('WheelHub'+nm,None); carcol.objects.link(hub); hub.parent=root; hub.location=(x,y,r); hub.empty_display_size=0.3
    bm=bmesh.new()
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm,cap_ends=True,segments=10,radius1=r,radius2=r,depth=0.32 if nm[0]=='F' else 0.38)
    bmesh.ops.rotate(bm,verts=bm.verts,cent=(0,0,0),matrix=__import__('mathutils').Matrix.Rotation(math.pi/2,3,'Y'))
    w=obj('Tire'+nm,bm,['Tire'],hub)
    bm=bmesh.new()
    bmesh.ops.create_cone(bm,cap_ends=True,segments=5,radius1=0.22,radius2=0.22,depth=0.02)
    bmesh.ops.rotate(bm,verts=bm.verts,cent=(0,0,0),matrix=__import__('mathutils').Matrix.Rotation(math.pi/2,3,'Y'))
    sx=(0.17 if nm[0]=='F' else 0.2)*(1 if x>0 else -1)
    rim=obj('Rim'+nm,bm,['Rim'],hub,(sx,0,0))
    wheels.append(hub)

import bpy, math
from mathutils import Vector
sc=bpy.context.scene
R=15.0; L1=40.0; A=math.pi/2*R; L2=35.0; TOTAL=L1+A+L2
def path(s):
    if s<=L1: return Vector((0,-L1+s,0)), Vector((0,1,0))
    if s<=L1+A:
        t=(s-L1)/R
        return Vector((R-R*math.cos(t), R*math.sin(t),0)), Vector((math.sin(t),math.cos(t),0))
    u=s-L1-A
    return Vector((R+u,R,0)), Vector((1,0,0))
car=bpy.data.objects['RaceCar']
hubs={n:bpy.data.objects['WheelHub'+n] for n in ('FL','FR','RL','RR')}
for o in [car,*hubs.values()]: o.animation_data_clear()
# start 5 m after the start line region, end before track end
s0=4.0; s1=TOTAL-6.0
r=0.36; prev_s=s0; spin=0
for f in range(1,121):
    u=(f-1)/119
    s=s0+(s1-s0)*(u-0.035*math.sin(2*math.pi*u))  # slight slow-down mid-run (the corner)
    p,d=path(s)
    car.location=p; car.rotation_euler=(0,0,math.atan2(-d.x,d.y))
    car.keyframe_insert('location',frame=f); car.keyframe_insert('rotation_euler',frame=f)
    spin+=(s-prev_s)/r; prev_s=s
    steer=-math.radians(12) if L1-2<s<L1+A-2 else 0.0
    for n,h in hubs.items():
        h.rotation_euler=(-spin,0,steer if n[0]=='F' else 0)
        h.keyframe_insert('rotation_euler',frame=f)
for o in [car,*hubs.values()]:
    for fc in o.animation_data.action.fcurves if hasattr(o.animation_data.action,'fcurves') else []:
        for k in fc.keyframe_points: k.interpolation='LINEAR'
# chase camera: reuse existing camera
cam=bpy.data.objects['Camera']; cam.name='ChaseCam'
cam.animation_data_clear(); cam.constraints.clear()
cam.parent=car; cam.matrix_parent_inverse.identity()
cam.location=(0,-8.5,3.2)
tgt=bpy.data.objects.get('ChaseTarget') or bpy.data.objects.new('ChaseTarget',None)
if tgt.name not in bpy.data.collections['Car'].objects: bpy.data.collections['Car'].objects.link(tgt)
tgt.parent=car; tgt.location=(0,5,0.8); tgt.empty_display_size=0.3
c=cam.constraints.new('TRACK_TO'); c.target=tgt; c.track_axis='TRACK_NEGATIVE_Z'; c.up_axis='UP_Y'
cam.data.lens=35; cam.data.clip_end=500
sc.camera=cam
sc.frame_set(1)
print(car.animation_data.action.name)
